beats.text: At the UN, Trump and Melania's escalator stopped dead, mid-ride, on live television.

beats.caption: Whoever is operating this teleprompter is in big trouble.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: According to CNBC, the UN says a staffer likely tripped the sensor by accident. Trump smelled sabotage.

beats.caption: A bad escalator and a bad teleprompter.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: He still gave the speech, and used it to grade every country on the planet.

beats.caption: Your countries are going to hell.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: Axios called it the line of the day. He also used the podium to relitigate windmills, which he apparently really hates.

beats.caption: Those big windmills are so pathetic and so bad.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: He also repeated his claim of ending seven, quote, unendable wars. PolitiFact checked the math and rated it Mostly False.

beats.caption: I have ended seven unendable wars.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: Sabotage claims, an unsolicited lecture, and a peace prize pitch the fact-checkers didn't buy. Efficient afternoon.
